page.content:
Aerial assassin whose New Japan chapter ran through United Empire.

How Will Ospreay connects

  • Faction: United Empire — Will Ospreay led United Empire during his New Japan heavyweight chapter.
  • Item: IWGP World Heavyweight Championship — Ospreay held the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship before leaving for AEW.

What is Will Ospreay?

Will Ospreay's New Japan years — junior ace, then heavyweight, then United Empire leader — produced IWGP United States and IWGP World Heavyweight title runs before his AEW move.

Key threads lead to United Empire and IWGP World Heavyweight Championship.
